title: POL-159: policy for the Contract Archive
body:
SCOPE:

The policy below governs use of the Contract Archive; it is
effective. Meridian Cloud audits compliance with the
controls listed here each year on behalf of the owner,
Daniel Ortega from Finance Operations.

REQUIREMENTS:

The requirements, last reviewed on 10 July 2025, are:
* Keep production data out of test and development
  environments
* Complete the annual security training before the published
  deadline
* Tag every cloud resource with an owner and a cost centre

STATUS:

The policy is effective according to the register. Issued by
Sofia Russo on 27 January 2025; 34 exceptions are on file
with Finance Operations and expire at the yearly audit.
